lines.trans: I heard shouting about the butter from across the courtyard.
Clara bought salted butter, so today we are making French-style eggs!
Good. Put these fresh herbs on top before serving them.
Did you plant those herbs yourself, Mateo?
Somebody has to look after the courtyard plants.
Smell that! Freshly baked bread, hot eggs, and fresh herbs.

words.gloss: to smell (oler a = to smell of/like)

lines.trans: Where do the teaspoons and the napkins go?
Put one napkin and one teaspoon beside every blue cup.
Seven twenty-nine on my watch. The guests are coming down already.
Four tables, eight chairs, everything in its place!
Pour the hot water into the teapot, Clara, here they come!

words.gloss: to come (el verano que viene = next summer)

lines.trans: Not bad for your second day, rookie.
I heard shouting about the butter from across the courtyard.
Clara bought salted butter, so today we are making French-style eggs!
Good. Put these fresh herbs on top before serving them.
Did you plant those herbs yourself, Mateo?
Somebody has to look after the courtyard plants.
Smell that! Freshly baked bread, hot eggs, and fresh herbs.

words.gloss: to smell (oler a = to smell of/like)

lines.trans: Where do the teaspoons and the napkins go?
Put one napkin and one teaspoon beside every blue cup.
Seven twenty-nine on my watch. The guests are coming down already.
Four tables, eight chairs, everything in its place!
Pour the hot water into the teapot, Clara, here they come!

I heard shouting about the butter from across the courtyard.
Clara bought salted butter, so today we are making French-style eggs!
Good. Put these fresh herbs on top before serving them.
Did you plant those herbs yourself, Mateo?
Somebody has to look after the courtyard plants.
Smell that! Freshly baked bread, hot eggs, and fresh herbs.

Seven twenty-nine on my watch. The guests are coming down already.
Four tables, eight chairs, everything in its place!

See you later!

meanings.note: Impersonal present form hay means 'there is / there are'; haber que + infinitive = must / need to.

examples.text: Hay pan caliente en la cocina.
examples.trans: There is warm bread in the kitchen.

examples.text: Ya hemos preparado las habitaciones.
examples.trans: We have already prepared the rooms.

meanings.note: Irregular: oigo, oyes, oye, oímos, oís, oyen; ¡Oiga! / ¡Oye! gets someone's attention.

examples.text: ¿Me oyes bien por teléfono?
examples.trans: Can you hear me clearly on the phone?

examples.text: Acabo de oír pasos en la escalera.
examples.trans: I just heard footsteps on the stairs.

meanings.note: Dar un grito = to let out a shout.

examples.text: El grito está aquí.
examples.trans: The shout is here.

examples.text: Vemos los gritos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the shouts from the door.

sobre.gloss: on; upon; about; out of (nueve sobre diez)

meanings.en: on; upon; about; out of (nueve sobre diez)
meanings.note: Sobre todo = above all / mostly; also a homograph noun el sobre ('envelope').

examples.text: Deja la llave sobre el mostrador.
examples.trans: Leave the key on the counter.

examples.text: Sacó nueve sobre diez en la prueba.
examples.trans: She scored nine out of ten on the test.

meanings.note: Definite feminine singular article before nouns; direct-object feminine pronoun before/attached to verbs.

examples.text: La puerta del patio es azul.
examples.trans: The courtyard door is blue.

examples.text: La habitación tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The room has plenty of light.

meanings.note: Spread on warm morning toast.

examples.text: La mantequilla es muy importante aquí.
examples.trans: The butter is very important here.

examples.text: Hablamos sobre la mantequilla.
examples.trans: We talk about the butter.

meanings.note: Marks a starting point in space or time.

examples.text: No hablamos desde aquel domingo.
examples.trans: We have not spoken since that Sunday.

examples.text: Abrimos al público desde mañana.
examples.trans: We open to the public starting tomorrow.

meanings.note: Definite article; also appears before feminine nouns starting with stressed /a/ (el agua, el asa).

examples.text: El patio tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The courtyard has plenty of light.

examples.text: Pásame el libro de reservas.
examples.trans: Pass me the reservation book.

meanings.note: Spanish never puts un/una before otro (otra taza = another cup; otra vez = again).

examples.text: ¿Quiere otra taza de café?
examples.trans: Would you like another cup of coffee?

examples.text: Míralo otra vez a la luz.
examples.trans: Look at it again in the light.

meanings.note: Al lado = on the side / next door.

examples.text: El lado está aquí.
examples.trans: The side is here.

examples.text: Vemos los lados desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the sides from the door.

meanings.note: Mandatory contraction of preposition de + masculine article el.

examples.text: El bizcocho acaba de salir del horno.
examples.trans: The cake just came out of the oven.

examples.text: Soy vecino del barrio.
examples.trans: I am a neighbour from the quarter.

meanings.note: Traditional inner courtyard at the heart of a Spanish building.

examples.text: El patio está aquí.
examples.trans: The courtyard is here.

examples.text: Vemos los patios desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the courtyards from the door.

meanings.note: Regular -ar verb.

examples.text: Compro pan caliente en la esquina.
examples.trans: I buy warm bread on the corner.

examples.text: Ayer compramos seis limones amarillos.
examples.trans: Yesterday we bought six yellow lemons.

meanings.note: Combines with mí/ti to form conmigo ('with me') and contigo ('with you').

examples.text: Tomo café con leche caliente.
examples.trans: I take coffee with hot milk.

examples.text: Habla con calma, por favor.
examples.trans: Speak calmly, please.

meanings.note: Con sal = salted; sin sal = unsalted.

examples.text: La sal es muy importante aquí.
examples.trans: The salt is very important here.

examples.text: Hablamos sobre la sal.
examples.trans: We talk about the salt.

meanings.note: Así que means 'so / therefore'.

examples.text: Hazlo así, despacio.
examples.trans: Do it like this, slowly.

examples.text: Llueve mucho, así que entramos.
examples.trans: It is raining hard, so let us go inside.

meanings.note: Core connector and relative pronoun (unaccented, distinct from interrogative qué).

examples.text: Espero que descanses muy bien.
examples.trans: I hope that you rest very well.

examples.text: El pan de esta panadería huele genial.
examples.trans: The bread that The baker bakes smells great.

meanings.note: El día de hoy = today.

examples.text: Hoy es viernes por fin.
examples.trans: Today is finally Friday.

examples.text: ¿Qué desayunamos hoy?
examples.trans: What are we having for breakfast today?

hacer.gloss: to do; to make; ago (hace + time)

meanings.en: to do; to make; ago (hace + time)
meanings.note: Irregular: hago, hice, hecho; hace tres años = three years ago.

examples.text: La panadera hace pan fresco cada mañana.
examples.trans: The baker bakes fresh bread every morning.

examples.text: Llegó hace diez minutos.
examples.trans: She arrived ten minutes ago.

meanings.note: Huevos revueltos = scrambled eggs.

examples.text: El huevo está aquí.
examples.trans: The egg is here.

examples.text: Vemos los huevos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the eggs from the door.

meanings.note: Mandatory contraction of preposition a + masculine article el; al + infinitive means 'upon doing'.

examples.text: Vamos al mercado por la mañana.
examples.trans: We go to the market in the morning.

examples.text: Al abrir la puerta, sonó el timbre.
examples.trans: Upon opening the door, the bell rang.

meanings.note: Al estilo francés = French-style.

examples.text: El estilo está aquí.
examples.trans: The style is here.

examples.text: Vemos los estilos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the styles from the door.

meanings.note: Forms: francés, francesa, franceses, francesas.

examples.text: Es una pieza francesa.
examples.trans: It is a French piece.

examples.text: al estilo francés
examples.trans: French-style

meanings.note: Before an adjective (bien caliente), means 'nice and hot'.

examples.text: Todo va muy bien hoy.
examples.trans: Everything is going very well today.

examples.text: El té sale bien caliente.
examples.trans: The tea comes out nice and hot.

poner.gloss: to put; to set; to become (ponerse + adj)

meanings.en: to put; to set; to become (ponerse + adj)
meanings.note: Irregular: pongo, pon, puse, puesto; ponerse nervioso = get nervous.

examples.text: Pongo dos tazas limpias en la mesa.
examples.trans: I put two clean cups on the table.

examples.text: Pon la maleta junto al mostrador.
examples.trans: Set the suitcase beside the counter.

meanings.note: Forms: este (m sg), esta (f sg), estos (m pl), estas (f pl).

examples.text: Este patio es muy tranquilo.
examples.trans: This courtyard is very quiet.

examples.text: Esta mañana hace mucho sol.
examples.trans: This morning it is very sunny.

meanings.note: Garden herbs or meadow grass.

examples.text: La hierba está aquí.
examples.trans: The herb is here.

examples.text: Vemos las hierbas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the herbs from the door.

meanings.note: Pintura fresca = wet paint; agua fresca = cool water.

examples.text: Es una pieza fresca.
examples.trans: It is a cool piece.

examples.text: Bien. Pon estas hierbas frescas por encima antes de servirlos.
examples.trans: Good. Put these fresh herbs on top before serving them.

por.gloss: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)

meanings.en: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)
meanings.note: Por la mañana = in the morning; por favor = please; gracias por = thanks for.

examples.text: Paseamos por el casco antiguo.
examples.trans: We stroll through the old quarter.

examples.text: Por la mañana entra mucho sol.
examples.trans: In the morning plenty of sun comes in.

meanings.note: Por encima = on top / over the surface.

examples.text: Pon azúcar glas por encima.
examples.trans: Put powdered sugar on top.

examples.text: Hay un cartel encima de la puerta.
examples.trans: There is a sign above the door.

meanings.note: Antes de means 'before' a noun or infinitive.

examples.text: Llegué diez minutos antes.
examples.trans: I arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: Antes de salir, cierra la ventana.
examples.trans: Before leaving, close the window.

meanings.note: Links possession, origin, material (de madera), and contents (taza de té).

examples.text: Es una mesa redonda de madera.
examples.trans: It is a round wooden table.

examples.text: Vengo de la estación de tren.
examples.trans: I am coming from the train station.

meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (e -> i: sirvo, sirve, sirvió).

examples.text: Servimos desayuno caliente de ocho a diez.
examples.trans: We serve hot breakfast from eight to ten.

examples.text: La encargada sirvió tres tazas de té de menta.
examples.trans: La encargada served three cups of mint tea.

meanings.note: Quedarse plantado = stand frozen/stranded.

examples.text: Es una pieza plantada.
examples.trans: It is a planted piece.

examples.text: ¿Has plantado tú mismo esas hierbas, Mateo?
examples.trans: Did you plant those herbs yourself, Mateo?

meanings.note: Accented subject pronoun (tú mismo = you yourself).

examples.text: Tú conoces muy bien el barrio.
examples.trans: You know the neighbourhood very well.

examples.text: Pruébalo tú mismo.
examples.trans: Try it yourself.

meanings.note: Agrees with the noun it describes.
In ahora mismo, meaning right now, mismo strengthens the time word ahora. Now comes from ahora; mismo supplies emphasis without agreeing with a person in this expression.

examples.text: Tenemos el mismo trabajo.
examples.trans: We have the same job.

examples.text: Ahora mismo estoy ocupada.
examples.trans: I am busy right now.

meanings.note: Forms: ese, esa, esos, esas.

examples.text: Pásame ese cuaderno azul.
examples.trans: Pass me that blue notebook.

examples.text: Esa maleta pertenece a un cliente.
examples.trans: That suitcase belongs to a guest.

meanings.note: Refers exclusively to people.

examples.text: Alguien acaba de llamar a la puerta.
examples.trans: Someone just knocked at the door.

examples.text: ¿Hay alguien en recepción?
examples.trans: Is anyone at the front desk?

tener.gloss: to have; to have to (tener que + inf)

meanings.en: to have; to have to (tener que + inf)
meanings.note: Used in idioms: tener hambre/frío/miedo/prisa/razón; tener que = must.

examples.text: Tenemos ocho habitaciones tranquilas.
examples.trans: We have eight quiet rooms.

examples.text: Tengo que cerrar la ventana ahora.
examples.trans: I have to close the window now.

cuidar.gloss: to look after; to take care of

meanings.en: to look after; to take care of
meanings.note: Regular -ar verb.

examples.text: Cuidamos cada detalle de la casa.
examples.trans: We look after every detail of the house.

examples.text: Ella cuida las plantas del balcón.
examples.trans: She tends the balcony plants.

meanings.note: Used with feminine plural nouns and clock hours (las ocho).

examples.text: Las ventanas dan al jardín.
examples.trans: The windows face the garden.

examples.text: Desayunamos a las ocho.
examples.trans: We have breakfast at eight.

meanings.note: Planta baja = ground floor; primera planta = first floor; also a green plant.

examples.text: La planta está aquí.
examples.trans: The floor / storey is here.

examples.text: Vemos las plantas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the floor / storeys from the door.

oler.gloss: to smell (oler a = to smell of/like)

meanings.en: to smell (oler a = to smell of/like)
meanings.note: Irregular boot stem hue- (huelo, hueles, huele, huelen).

examples.text: La cocina huele a canela caliente.
examples.trans: The kitchen smells like warm cinnamon.

examples.text: El jardín huele a flores frescas.
examples.trans: The garden smells of fresh flowers.

meanings.note: Neuter pronoun; por eso = that is why.

examples.text: Por eso traje dos paraguas.
examples.trans: That is why I brought two umbrellas.

examples.text: ¿Qué significa eso exactamente?
examples.trans: What does that mean exactly?

meanings.note: Plural los panes; pan recién hecho = freshly baked bread.

examples.text: El pan es muy importante aquí.
examples.trans: The bread is very important here.

examples.text: Hablamos sobre el pan.
examples.trans: We talk about the bread.

meanings.note: Pan recién hecho = freshly baked bread; recién salido del horno = fresh out of the oven.

examples.text: Tenemos pan recién hecho cada día.
examples.trans: We have freshly baked bread every day.

examples.text: El zumo está recién exprimido.
examples.trans: The juice is freshly squeezed.

meanings.note: Irregular past participle of hacer (recién hecho = freshly made).

examples.text: Es una pieza hecha.
examples.trans: It is a made piece.

examples.text: ¡Son bollos recién hechos! Toma uno, todavía está caliente.
examples.trans: They are freshly baked rolls! Take one, it is still warm.

meanings.note: Describes hot drinks, food, or water.

examples.text: Es una pieza caliente.
examples.trans: It is a hot piece.

examples.text: Aquí tiene, señora: té caliente de menta con miel.
examples.trans: Here you are, madam: hot mint tea with honey.

meanings.note: Changes to e before words starting with /i/ sound (i- or hi-).

examples.text: Servimos café caliente y pan fresco.
examples.trans: We serve hot coffee and fresh bread.

examples.text: Son las siete y cuarto.
examples.trans: It is quarter past seven.

meanings.note: Interrogative adverb with written accent.

examples.text: Mira dónde señala con el lápiz.
examples.trans: Look where he is pointing with his pencil.

examples.text: ¿Dónde van las cucharillas y las servilletas?
examples.trans: Where do the teaspoons and the napkins go?

meanings.note: Ir a + infinitive expresses near future ('going to do').

examples.text: Voy a abrir la puerta ahora.
examples.trans: I am going to open the door now.

examples.text: ¿Cómo va todo esta mañana?
examples.trans: How is everything going this morning?

meanings.note: Small spoon for coffee, tea, or dessert.

examples.text: La cucharilla está aquí.
examples.trans: The teaspoon is here.

examples.text: Vemos las cucharillas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the teaspoons from the door.

meanings.note: Cloth or paper table napkin.

examples.text: La servilleta está aquí.
examples.trans: The napkin is here.

examples.text: Vemos las servilletas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the napkins from the door.

meanings.note: Forms: un (m sg), una (f sg), unos (m pl 'some/about'), unas (f pl).

examples.text: Quiero un café caliente, por favor.
examples.trans: I would like a hot coffee, please.

examples.text: Hay una mesa libre en el patio.
examples.trans: There is a free table in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Invariable before masculine or feminine singular nouns (cada día, cada mañana).

examples.text: Abro la cafetería cada mañana.
examples.trans: I open the cafe every morning.

examples.text: Cada habitación tiene su llave.
examples.trans: Each room has its own key.

meanings.note: Una taza de té = a cup of tea.

examples.text: La taza está aquí.
examples.trans: The cup is here.

examples.text: Vemos las tazas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the cups from the door.

meanings.note: Plural azules; azul marino means 'navy blue'.

examples.text: Es una pieza azul.
examples.trans: It is a blue piece.

examples.text: Espere, ¡es azul oscuro, igual que la suya!
examples.trans: Wait, it is dark blue, just like yours!

meanings.note: Las siete y cuarto = seven fifteen.

examples.text: La habitación siete mira al patio.
examples.trans: Room seven overlooks the courtyard.

examples.text: Desayunamos a las siete y media.
examples.trans: We have breakfast at seven thirty.

meanings.note: Single fused word for veinte + y + nueve.

examples.text: Febrero tiene veintinueve días ese año.
examples.trans: February has twenty-nine days that year.

examples.text: Conté veintinueve monedas de cambio.
examples.trans: I counted twenty-nine coins in change.

meanings.note: Expresses location inside or on top of a surface (en la mesa = on the table).

examples.text: Las tazas están en la mesa.
examples.trans: The cups are on the table.

examples.text: Vivimos en Valencia todo el año.
examples.trans: We live in Valencia all year.

meanings.note: Plural mis (mi llave / mis llaves); unaccented, distinct from pronoun mí.

examples.text: Mi maleta es azul marino.
examples.trans: My suitcase is navy blue.

examples.text: Mis apuntes están en el bolsillo.
examples.trans: My notes are in my pocket.

meanings.note: Covers wristwatches, wall clocks, and church tower clocks (plural: relojes).

examples.text: El reloj está aquí.
examples.trans: The watch is here.

examples.text: Vemos los relojes desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the watchs from the door.

meanings.note: Los viernes means 'every Friday / on Fridays'.

examples.text: Los vecinos vienen a desayunar.
examples.trans: The neighbours come for breakfast.

examples.text: Daba clases de piano los viernes.
examples.trans: She taught piano lessons on Fridays.

meanings.note: Can take el or la, alongside dedicated feminine clienta.

examples.text: El cliente está aquí.
examples.trans: The guest is here.

examples.text: Vemos los clientes desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the guests from the door.

meanings.note: ¡Ya está! = All done!; ya no = no longer.

examples.text: El desayuno ya está listo.
examples.trans: Breakfast is already ready.

examples.text: ¡Ya voy con las llaves!
examples.trans: Coming right now with the keys!

bajar.gloss: to go down; to bring down; to lower

meanings.en: to go down; to bring down; to lower
meanings.note: Works both intransitively (go downstairs) and transitively (bring down).

examples.text: Bajo a la cocina a preparar té.
examples.trans: I go down to the kitchen to make tea.

examples.text: Bajamos las maletas por la escalera.
examples.trans: We bring the suitcases down the stairs.

meanings.note: Invariable cardinal number.

examples.text: Tenemos cuatro mesas dentro.
examples.trans: We have four tables inside.

examples.text: La habitación cuatro da al patio.
examples.trans: Room four looks out onto the courtyard.

meanings.note: Dining, cafe, or courtyard table.

examples.text: La mesa está aquí.
examples.trans: The table is here.

examples.text: Vemos las mesas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the tables from the door.

meanings.note: Las ocho = eight o'clock.

examples.text: Abrimos la puerta a las ocho.
examples.trans: We open the door at eight.

examples.text: La posada tiene ocho habitaciones.
examples.trans: The guesthouse has eight rooms.

meanings.note: Wooden or folding chair.

examples.text: La silla está aquí.
examples.trans: The chair is here.

examples.text: Vemos las sillas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the chairs from the door.

meanings.note: Todo el día = the whole day; todo el mundo = everyone; sobre todo = mostly.

examples.text: Todo está limpio y en su sitio.
examples.trans: Everything is clean and in its place.

examples.text: Camina todo recto por esta calle.
examples.trans: Walk straight ahead down this street.

su.gloss: his; her; its; their; your (polite usted/ustedes)

meanings.en: his; her; its; their; your (polite usted/ustedes)
meanings.note: Plural sus (su maleta / sus maletas).

examples.text: Aquí tiene su llave, señora.
examples.trans: Here is your key, madam.

examples.text: Sus habitaciones están en la primera planta.
examples.trans: Your rooms are on the first floor.

meanings.note: Everyday Peninsula favourite for 'place' or 'seat'.

examples.text: El sitio está aquí.
examples.trans: The place is here.

examples.text: Vemos los sitios desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the place from the door.

echar.gloss: to pour; to toss; to miss (echar de menos)

meanings.en: to pour; to toss; to miss (echar de menos)
meanings.note: Echar un vistazo = take a glance; echar de menos = miss someone.

examples.text: Echa un poco más de agua caliente.
examples.trans: Pour a little more hot water.

examples.text: Te he echado mucho de menos.
examples.trans: I have missed you very much.

meanings.note: Feminine noun that takes el in the singular before stressed initial /a/ (el agua fría).

examples.text: Quiero un vaso de agua fría.
examples.trans: I want a glass of cold water.

examples.text: El agua de la ducha sale caliente.
examples.trans: The shower water comes out hot.

meanings.note: Built from té (tea).

examples.text: La tetera está aquí.
examples.trans: The teapot is here.

examples.text: Vemos las teteras desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the teapots from the door.

venir.gloss: to come (el verano que viene = next summer)

meanings.en: to come (el verano que viene = next summer)
meanings.note: Irregular: vengo, vienes, viene, vine.

examples.text: Gracias por venir esta mañana.
examples.trans: Thank you for coming this morning.

examples.text: Nos vemos la semana que viene.
examples.trans: See you next week.

nada.gloss: nothing; not at all (de nada = you're welcome)

meanings.en: nothing; not at all (de nada = you're welcome)
meanings.note: No pasa nada = no problem; nada de... = no ... at all.

examples.text: Tranquilo, no pasa nada.
examples.trans: Easy now, there is no problem at all.

examples.text: No queda nada de mantequilla.
examples.trans: There is no butter left at all.

meanings.note: Nada mal = not bad at all; menos mal = thank goodness.

examples.text: Nada mal para el primer día.
examples.trans: Not bad at all for the first day.

examples.text: ¡Menos mal que trajiste paraguas!
examples.trans: Thank goodness you brought an umbrella!

meanings.note: Marks destination, recipient (para ti), deadline, and minutes to the hour (cinco para las doce).

examples.text: Este paquete blanco es para mi hermano.
examples.trans: This white parcel is for my brother.

examples.text: Faltan diez minutos para las doce.
examples.trans: It is ten minutes to twelve.

meanings.note: Unaccented possessive (tu llave / tus llaves), distinct from accented pronoun tú.

examples.text: ¿Dónde está tu caja de herramientas?
examples.trans: Where is your toolbox?

examples.text: Reconocí tu letra enseguida.
examples.trans: I recognized your handwriting right away.

meanings.note: Also a masculine noun (un segundo = one second).

examples.text: Es una pieza segunda.
examples.trans: It is a second piece.

examples.text: Segunda: Te he echado de menos estos tres años.
examples.trans: Second: I missed you these three years.

meanings.note: Masculine despite ending in -a: el día, ¡Buenos días!.

examples.text: El día está aquí.
examples.trans: The day is here.

examples.text: Vemos los días desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the days from the door.

meanings.note: Friendly teasing word for a new team member (masculine: el novato).

examples.text: La novata está aquí.
examples.trans: The rookie is here.

examples.text: Vemos las novatas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the rookies from the door.

meanings.note: ¡Hasta luego! = See you later!; ¡Hasta mañana! = See you tomorrow!

examples.text: Sigue recto hasta el puente.
examples.trans: Walk straight ahead as far as the bridge.

examples.text: Nos quedamos hasta el viernes.
examples.trans: We are staying until Friday.

meanings.note: ¡Hasta luego! is Spain's most common everyday farewell.

examples.text: Cruza el puente y luego gira.
examples.trans: Cross the bridge and then turn.

examples.text: ¡Hasta luego, que tengas buen día!
examples.trans: See you later, have a good day!
